raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (ingest 2026-01-19) is the only batch tagged source_tz='UTC', and its txn_ts values are UTC, while batches 1-13 are America/Chicago local time. The 99 rows timestamped 2026-01-19 00:00-06:00 are UTC-stamped activity that is really 2026-01-18 18:00-24:00 Chicago time, so silver_transactions assigns them to the wrong txn_date without converting to local time.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "WITH t AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM t;"}}
